_comment: Identity and machine paths for python_scripts/build_mod_release.py. Release ticket 01 owns public_name and version; while identity_frozen is false the build stamps '-provisional' into the archive filename so a verification build cannot be mistaken for an upload candidate. Paths use forward slashes; pathlib resolves them on Windows.
_identities_comment: Names the real-name guard must NOT flag. author_public plus these: the GitHub handle, the web-UI committer name that signs merges made on github.com, and upstream's handle, which is a credit the README carries on purpose.
